items.title: fix(gateway): give each utility fallback its own observer deadline (#…
items.summary: fix(gateway): give each utility fallback its own observer deadline (#191653) The observer bounded model preparation and the whole utility fallback chain with one 30s abort timer, while each candidate received the same 30s as its own call timeout. A primary that used its budget left the configured fallback no time at all, so two such failures disabled assessments for the run. Size the deadline by the configured candidate count so every candidate can use a full call. Single-model configs keep the original 30s bound.
